175    private function addTimeInterval($date, $endless_reminder_frequency_id): ?Carbon
176    {
177        if (! $date) {
178            return null;
179        }
180
181        switch ($endless_reminder_frequency_id) {
182            case RecurringInvoice::FREQUENCY_DAILY:
183                return Carbon::parse($date)->addDay()->startOfDay();
184            case RecurringInvoice::FREQUENCY_WEEKLY:
185                return Carbon::parse($date)->addWeek()->startOfDay();
186            case RecurringInvoice::FREQUENCY_TWO_WEEKS:
187                return Carbon::parse($date)->addWeeks(2)->startOfDay();
188            case RecurringInvoice::FREQUENCY_FOUR_WEEKS:
189                return Carbon::parse($date)->addWeeks(4)->startOfDay();
190            case RecurringInvoice::FREQUENCY_MONTHLY:
191                return Carbon::parse($date)->addMonthNoOverflow()->startOfDay();
192            case RecurringInvoice::FREQUENCY_TWO_MONTHS:
193                return Carbon::parse($date)->addMonthsNoOverflow(2)->startOfDay();
194            case RecurringInvoice::FREQUENCY_THREE_MONTHS:
195                return Carbon::parse($date)->addMonthsNoOverflow(3)->startOfDay();
196            case RecurringInvoice::FREQUENCY_FOUR_MONTHS:
197                return Carbon::parse($date)->addMonthsNoOverflow(4)->startOfDay();
198            case RecurringInvoice::FREQUENCY_SIX_MONTHS:
199                return Carbon::parse($date)->addMonthsNoOverflow(6)->startOfDay();
200            case RecurringInvoice::FREQUENCY_ANNUALLY:
201                return Carbon::parse($date)->addYear()->startOfDay();
202            case RecurringInvoice::FREQUENCY_TWO_YEARS:
203                return Carbon::parse($date)->addYears(2)->startOfDay();
204            case RecurringInvoice::FREQUENCY_THREE_YEARS:
205                return Carbon::parse($date)->addYears(3)->startOfDay();
206            default:
207                return null;
208        }
209    }
